methods.channel_decomposition: least-squares fit of C6(theta) onto the three dipole-dipole angular channels (dM=0 -> (1-3cos^2 theta)^2, dM=+-1 -> sin^2 theta cos^2 theta, dM=+-2 -> sin^4 theta), per Wadenpfuhl2025

conventions.c6_sign: interaction potential V(r) = -C6/r^6; C6 < 0 => repulsive, C6 > 0 => attractive
conventions.angle: theta = angle between interatomic axis and quantization axis; theta=0 along quantization axis, theta=90 perpendicular

angular_channels_wadenpfuhl2025.value: dM=0 -> (1-3cos^2 theta), dM=+-1 -> sin(theta)cos(theta), dM=+-2 -> sin^2(theta); squared in 2nd order gives (1-3cos^2)^2, sin^2 cos^2, sin^4

premise_corrections.premise: prior project single_photon_297nm lead: PP vdW anisotropy ~1e6 (field-free), i.e. theta=0 residual negligible
premise_corrections.corrected: the ~1e6-1e8 anisotropy is an artifact of the pairinteraction degenerate-perturbation C6 class (returns near-zero theta=0 residual). The TRUE theta=0 residual is -10.41 GHz um^6 at n=60 (repulsive, dM=0 S+D channel), giving a physical anisotropy ~26x (both-diagonalization 268.08/10.41) to ~29x (mixed perturbative 299.11/10.41).
premise_corrections.consequence: downstream E2 packing gain must use ~26-29x (not ~1e6x, and not the earlier ~18x which was based on the truncated -16.16). The PP theta=0 residual -10.4 GHz um^6 is ~7.5% of the SS C6 at n=60 (10.4 vs 138.9).

near_forster_flags.note: S+S Forster defect small but nonzero; perturbative C6(90 deg)=2883 GHz um^6 still follows ~n^11. Flag: treat perturbative C6 near n=75-80 cautiously (defect 0.185-0.161 GHz, decreasing toward a resonance above n=80).

energy_window_truncation_finding.claim: The prior theta=0 residual -16.16 GHz um^6 was an artifact of the DEFAULT +/-20 GHz energy window, which keeps the repulsive S+D channels (|defect| below 20 GHz, cumulative -16.16) but EXCLUDES the attractive D+D channels (defect +20..30 GHz, +6.5), whose cancellation yields the true residual -10.41 GHz um^6.
energy_window_truncation_finding.conclusion: diagonalization energy-window dependence exactly tracks the second-order-sum cumulative contribution vs |defect|; both converge to -10.41 GHz um^6 once the energy window exceeds ~60 GHz.

headline_findings: SS (Rb nS1/2) is isotropic to under 2% across n=40-80; C6_SS(60) = -138.9 GHz um^6, now independently confirmed by three methods: pairinteraction -138.86, Singer n^11 formula -140.27 (1.0%), ARC -141.15 (1.6%). C6_SS(43) = -2.441 (Low2012 0.014%).

PP stretched (Rb nP3/2 |m=3/2|) is sin^4-theta dominant to better than 99.999%; C6_PP(90 deg, 60) = +268..299 GHz um^6 (attractive, near-Forster S+S channel, defect 0.278 GHz), confirmed by pairinteraction 299.11, ARC 292.4 (2.3%), diagonalization 268.08 (10% near-Forster spread).

CONVERGED theta=0 residual is -10.41 GHz um^6 at n=60 (repulsive, dM=0 S+D channel), confirmed by three independent methods (wide-window diagonalization -10.408, all-channel second-order sum -10.412, ARC blind 10.4+/-3) to 0.04%. The prior -16.16 was a +/-20 GHz energy-window truncation artifact.

The physical PP anisotropy is ~26x (both-diagonalization 268.08/10.41) to ~29x (mixed perturbative 299.11/10.41), NOT ~1e6, NOT ~18x, and NOT the stale 18-60x (which was based on the truncated -16.16 and a single-channel -4.96 partial sum). The theta=0 residual is ~7.5% of the SS C6 at n=60.

NEW (Issue 6): the PP theta=90 C6 scales as n*^9.48 over n=50-80, DEPARTING from the (n*)^11 Singer/Saffman prediction; attributed to the near-Forster S+S resonance structure (1/Delta denominator). The SS pair scales as n*^11.33, close to n^11.

Cross-validation: SS agrees 0.3% (perturbative vs diag) and ~1-2% (Singer/ARC); PP theta=90 agrees ~2-10% (near-Forster); PP theta=0 RESOLVED: wide-window diagonalization (-10.408) and all-channel second-order sum (-10.412) agree 0.04%, ARC blind 10.4+/-3 confirms.

pp_theta90_n_scaling_finding.claim: The PP theta=90 deg C6 scales as n*^9.48 over n=50-80 (vs n* with Rb P3/2 quantum defect 2.64), DEPARTING from the (n*)^11 Singer/Saffman prediction (Wadenpfuhl2025). The SS pair by contrast scales as n*^11.33 (close to n^11).
pp_theta90_n_scaling_finding.attribution: the PP theta=90 C6 is dominated by the near-Forster S+S channel (defect 0.278 GHz at n=60) with C6 ~ |C3|^2/Delta; the 1/Delta denominator (resonance structure) modifies the n^11 scaling toward ~n*^9.5. The low-n region (40-45) is non-monotonic (defect crossing), further confirming resonance-driven departure.
pp_theta90_n_scaling_finding.status: attributed to near-Forster resonance structure (consistent with Wadenpfuhl2025's angular-channel treatment); flagged as open if a non-resonant n-region is needed for clean scaling.

theta0_discrepancy_resolution.claim: The 'factor-3.3 discrepancy' (-4.96 vs -16.16) and '18-60 anisotropy range' in the pre-revision review were based on TWO stale artifacts, now both explained: (a) -4.96 was the SINGLE dominant channel (60S1/2+59D5/2, one symmetric partner), not the total second-order sum (-10.41 with both partners -9.92 plus other channels); (b) -16.16 was the +/-20 GHz energy-window truncation (converged diagonalization is -10.41).

acceptance_criterion: Confirmatory. Predict: (i) the SS pair C6 is isotropic (|C6(90 deg)/C6(0 deg)| in [0.9,1.1] for every scanned n); (ii) the PP stretched-pair C6 is sin^4-theta dominant (angular-channel sin4_fraction > 0.9 for every scanned n); (iii) the field-standard anchors reproduce: 43S |C6| within 5% of Low2012 2.441 GHz um^6 and 70S |C6| within the Walker2008 set {862,891} GHz um^6 (~10%). Verdict reads computed.c6_ss_anisotropy_ratio_by_n, computed.c6_pp_sin4_fraction_by_n, computed.c6_ss_43s_ghz_um6, computed.c6_ss_70s_ghz_um6. CONFIRMED iff all three hold; REFUTED if the SS pair is anisotropic (>10% off 1), or the PP pair is not sin^4-dominant (sin4_fraction <= 0.9), or either anchor is off by more than its tolerance. Single-fault response: an artifact that returned a constant or isotropic PP C6 would fail condition (ii); one that returned a constant SS C6 would fail condition (i); one that returned zero/constant C6 would fail condition (iii).
headline_findings: SS (Rb nS1/2) is isotropic to <2% across n=40-80 (anisotropy ratio 1.012-1.019); C6_SS(60) = -138.9 GHz um^6, C6_SS(70) = -868.6 GHz um^6, C6_SS(43) = -2.441 GHz um^6 (matches Low2012 to 0.014%).

PP stretched (Rb nP3/2 |m=3/2|) is sin^4-theta dominant to >99.999% (sin4_fraction = 0.9999999); C6_PP(90 deg, 60) = +299.1 GHz um^6 (attractive), C6_PP(90 deg, 75) = +2883 GHz um^6 (near-Forster enhanced).

The theta=0 residual is the load-bearing correction: full pair-Hamiltonian diagonalization gives C6_PP(0 deg) = -16.2 GHz um^6 at n=60 (repulsive), growing to -289 GHz um^6 at n=80, dominated by the dM=0 S+D channel. The pairinteraction degenerate-perturbation C6 class instead returns ~0 (-1.4e-5), missing this channel.
Therefore the physical PP anisotropy is ~18x at n=60 (299/16.2), NOT ~1e6-1e8. The residual at theta=0 is ~12% of the SS C6 at n=60, so the tight-packing floor is set by -16 GHz um^6, not zero.
Cross-validation: SS pair (perturbative vs diagonalization) agrees to 0.3%; PP theta=90 agrees to 10%; PP theta=0 is DISCREPANT by ~1e6 (recorded, not resolved).
